desc: Poor indoor air quality is an incredibly common problem that can affect you in many ways. Read on to learn how to combat!

blocks.text: Poor indoor air quality is an incredibly common problem that can affect you in many ways. Indoor air is generally always much more polluted than the air outside, and there really isn’t much you can do to prevent this from being the case. As such, it’s always a good idea to take some steps to improve the quality of the air in your home, and installing a whole-home air purification system is the most effective option in this regard. To help you understand why whole-home air purification can be such a good investment, here are some of the biggest benefits this type of system will provide.

Whole-home air purifiers are extremely effective and will filter out almost all allergens from your home’s air. Dust, pollen, dust mites and mold spores are found in every building, and there is no effective way to keep these allergens out. If you have pets in the home, you’ll also have lots of pet dander present that can also trigger allergy symptoms and asthma. With a whole-home air purification system, you’ll be able to breathe more easily and suffer from fewer symptoms since the system will constantly work to remove allergens and prevent them from being spread around the home when your heating or air conditioning is on.

Chemicals are also always present in the air in any building, which means that you’re constantly exposed to potentially harmful contaminants that can impact your health in both the short and long term. Many chemicals like chlorine, formaldehyde, ammonia and benzene are naturally given off by cleaning agents as well as your home’s furniture and building materials. Chemicals are also given off any time you cook indoors, and even doing laundry contributes to higher chemical concentrations in the home since things like laundry detergent, fabric softener and especially dryer sheets contain many different chemicals that they release into the air. This is another area where whole-home air purification can provide great benefits as the system will also work to filter out and eliminate most airborne chemicals.

Whole-home air purification can also help keep you and your family healthier and prevent airborne illnesses like colds and the flu. This is because an air purification system will work to eliminate bacteria and viruses from the air in your home. This is especially true if you choose a system that has a UV air sanitizer. Ultraviolet light works by altering the DNA of bacteria and viruses, which instantly makes them harmless so that they can no longer spread, infect or reproduce.

Whole-home air purification can also help keep your home smelling fresher and cleaner by eliminating or neutralizing unpleasant odors. Many bad smells are produced by odor-causing bacteria that release foul-smelling compounds into the air as they feed. The formaldehyde and other chemicals given off by furnishings, building materials and cleaning agents can also contribute to your home not smelling all that nice. Whole-home air purification can help overcome these problems by eliminating odor-causing bacteria and filtering out chemicals. This type of system will also be extremely effective at eliminating odors caused by cooking.

Getting a good night’s sleep is extremely important for your overall health and your productivity, and poor indoor air quality in your bedroom will often make it nearly impossible to sleep as well or as soundly as you should. Mold spores, pollen and dust mites on your bedding and in the air can irritate your respiratory system and cause symptoms like coughing, wheezing, nasal congestion and sneezing that interrupt your sleep. These problems are obviously worse for people with asthma and frequent allergies, but the fact is that lots of particles and pollution in the air can always make it more difficult to breathe, resulting in your sleep being disrupted or making you more restless. By eliminating allergens and airborne pollution, a whole-home air purification system will make it much easier to get the quality sleep you need every night.
